gloss: chunky sweet bean paste; coarse red bean paste

definitions.gloss: chunky sweet bean paste; coarse red bean paste
definitions.explanation: Sweet red bean paste (あんこ) in which the azuki beans are only partially mashed, leaving visible bean pieces for a chunky texture.

examples.japanese: {粒|つぶ}あん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大福|だいふく}→大福：12173_daifuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like daifuku with chunky bean paste.

examples.japanese: {粒|つぶ}あん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦こしあん→こしあん：20791_koshian⟧、⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Which do you prefer, chunky or smooth bean paste?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{和菓子屋|わがしや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粒|つぶ}あん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小豆|あずき}→小豆：10209_azuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The chunky bean paste at this Japanese sweets shop retains a firm azuki bean texture.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧ (grain, particle) + あん (sweet bean paste). One of two main types of sweet red bean paste, distinguished by its chunky texture with visible bean pieces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粒|つぶ}あん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大福|だいふく}→大福：12173_daifuku⟧: daifuku with chunky bean paste
- {粒|つぶ}あん⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧: bread filled with chunky bean paste
- {粒|つぶ}あん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おはぎ→おはぎ：29365_ohagi⟧: ohagi with chunky bean paste
- ⟦{自家製|じかせい}→自家製：13947_jikasei⟧{粒|つぶ}あん: homemade chunky bean paste

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦こしあん→こしあん：20791_koshian⟧: smooth bean paste — strained to remove skins, completely smooth texture
- {粒|つぶ}あん vs ⟦こしあん→こしあん：20791_koshian⟧ is one of the classic preference debates in Japan, similar to the debate over crunchy vs smooth peanut butter

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as {粒餡|つぶあん}. Sometimes called {小倉|おぐら}あん ({小倉餡|おぐらあん}).

RELATED WORDS:
- あんこ: sweet bean paste (general term)
- ⟦{小豆|あずき}→小豆：10209_azuki⟧: azuki beans (the base ingredient)
- ⟦こしあん→こしあん：20791_koshian⟧: smooth/strained bean paste
